title: Non-anchor absolute-position period-7 prediction v44
rationale: This lane predeclares an absolute-position period-7 residue target before any new observation file is scored. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery does not use public known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate key material, routed-key results, held-out anchor controls, or source-expanded candidate screens. The lane is a pure independent prediction target: it can only gain evidentiary weight from future source-reviewed non-anchor observations fixed before evaluation.
prediction_target: Future independently documented non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared one-based absolute-position residue classes for period 7 at a rate exceeding seeded null, best-of-residue, and multiple-comparison controls.
discovery_inputs: Absolute one-based K4 position residues for predeclared period 7 emitted before future observation scoring
K4 ciphertext length fixes the finite position universe
Non-anchor complement mask fixed before any observation scoring
No candidate words, key material, routes, plaintext guesses, or additive fragment values used to select the residue target
evaluation_inputs: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations
Source-reviewed observation files with source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale declared before evaluation
Position-only scoring target that excludes public anchor additive fragments as primary evidence
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position shuffle baseline
best-of-residue null over all period-7 residue classes
multiple-comparison correction across the period-7 residue targets
public-anchor positions excluded from scoring and never used as primary evidence
require-unique-artifact gate before treating this as a distinct prediction target
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
